name: Saint Mary Magdalene
history: A woman of Magdala in Galilee from whom Christ cast out seven devils. She followed Him with the other women, stood by the cross, and was the first to see Him risen, sent by Him to tell the apostles. The Church calls her the apostle to the apostles, and in 2016 her memorial was raised to a feast.
life: Saint Luke names Mary Magdalene first among the women who travelled with Jesus and provided for Him out of their means. When the apostles fled, she stood at the cross with the Mother of Jesus, and she watched where He was laid. Early on the first day of the week she came to the tomb and found it empty. Weeping, she did not know the risen Christ until He spoke her name, and she answered, ‘Rabboni.’ He told her not to cling to Him but to go to His brethren, and she went and announced, ‘I have seen the Lord.’ Western tradition, following Saint Gregory the Great, long identified her with the woman who wept over Christ’s feet and with Mary of Bethany, and so she became the great model of the repentant sinner. The calendar now distinguishes them, but her love and her tears for the Lord are certain.
prayerTo: Saint Mary Magdalene, you were set free by Christ and loved Him to the end, at the cross and at the empty tomb. Pray for all who are bound by sin or by evil, for those who weep, and for me, that I may know the Lord when He calls my name and run to tell others. Amen.
penance: Go to Confession if you can, or make a careful examination of conscience tonight. Tell one person today something Christ has done for you.
meditation: She did not recognise Him until He said her name. Be still today and let Him say yours.
prayer: May the prayers of blessed Mary Magdalen help us, O Lord, Who were moved by her prayers and brought back alive from the grave her brother Lazarus, dead for four days. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
